About Underwater Garbage Detection

Underwater Garbage Detection is an AI-based system designed to identify and classify waste materials in underwater environments. The system uses the YOLOv8 deep learning model to detect objects such as plastic bottles, plastic bags, and other marine debris.

This project helps in protecting marine ecosystems by enabling automated monitoring and detection of underwater pollution. It can assist researchers, environmental organizations, and governments in cleaning oceans and preserving marine life.

Technologies used in this project include Python, YOLOv8, Flask for backend detection, and React for the frontend interface.
